dog.description_text:
Pierce is a 4-year-old terrier mix who weighs around 17 lbs and is such a sweet, snuggly little guy. He’s friendly, affectionate, and not shy about showing how excited he is to see his people.

He also loves to play fetch and is always happy to chase after a ball before settling in for some cuddles. Pierce is a very good boy with a fun, loving personality and plenty of affection to give.

Registered adopters interested in Pierce can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
